## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `CRITERION_HINT` should be fixed because it tells writers to omit "shall", and the validator rejects exactly those criteria when `require_shall` is enabled.

## Changes
The pull request rewords `CRITERION_HINT` and `BULLET_HINT` in `app/criteria.py` and leaves `accepts_criterion` and its tests unchanged. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root that the pull-request description does not mention.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make CRITERION_HINT valid when require_shall is enabled — With `require_shall=True`, a criterion written to the new hint, such as `- Save the result`, is rejected. `app/criteria.py:8` returns `" shall " in text`, and `tests/test_criteria.py:21` asserts that rejection. — Anyone who follows the hint where `require_shall` is enabled writes criteria that the validator rejects. — Fix: Either drop the "without the word shall" clause or select the hint text from the `require_shall` setting.
